result.rationale: HOLD on a separate Bay Area guide for now. The data supports demand only for generic 'sell hoarder house' queries (1037 impressions, 0 clicks, position 16.3), and /hoarder-houses/ already ranks for them. No Bay Area modifier appears in the data, so a Bay Area framing has no measured query set of its own. The Bay Area angle would be an informational how-to guide for Bay Area readers dealing with a hoarded home: what to expect, how to approach the clean-out and sale options, and how state law and local rules differ, stated as separate layers and only from official prints Leo supplies. The page it could cannibalize most is the existing post /sell-bay-area-house-full-of-belongings/, because that post already pairs the Bay Area with a house full of belongings. The money page /hoarder-houses/ is a lesser risk, since the guide would answer 'how do I deal with this' while the money page answers 'sell it to us'. To keep the intents apart, /hoarder-houses/ keeps the transactional 'sell a hoarder house' queries. The post keeps the general Bay Area full-of-belongings sale. A guide, if any, would take only a distinct informational sub-intent that the post does not cover, and would link to the money page without repeating its queries. Overlap with the post cannot be judged from the packet, which holds no data for it. I need its GSC queries and inventory entry (listed in required_actions). Until then HOLD, not CREATE, because an existing page may already cover the intent. If the post turns out to cover it, an UPDATE or a section on that post is the better route.
